sources.snippet: Golden Agentic Dataset v3 ONE unified golden dataset for training agentic AI coding assistants with 100% tool-calling accuracy. Built from 5 real HuggingFace sources + 2,500 synthetic hard samples. 13,438 samples | 100% validation | 69 MB native Tool calling + code generation + chain-of-thought reasoning Unsloth-compatible (ChatML + SFT formats)
